cards.answer: Smolder is a marksman/mage whose basic abilities grow stronger through Dragon Practice stacks. He builds toward AD and uses physical-damage abilities, with added magic damage from stacks and a true-damage burn and low-health execute on upgraded Q.
cards.counterplay: Limit free ability hits, avoid clustering around his targets, and respect his upgraded Q when low on health.

cards.answer: Dragon Practice gains stacks when Smolder hits champions with abilities or kills minions and monsters with Q. Stacks add magic damage to his basic abilities.
cards.counterplay: Avoid giving him free ability hits while contesting his farming.

cards.answer: Q fires a targeted fireball that deals physical damage. As Dragon Practice grows, it gains an explosion, then extra fire bolts, then a maximum-health true-damage burn. Once upgraded with the burn, Smolder's damage can execute burned champions at low health.
cards.counterplay: Space away from his target and nearby allies; disengage earlier when low on health against his upgraded Q.

cards.answer: W sends a projectile that deals physical damage and slows enemies hit. Hitting a champion creates an explosion that damages nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the projectile and avoid clustering around allies in its path.

cards.answer: E briefly grants movement speed and lets Smolder fly through terrain while automatically firing physical-damage bolts at a nearby enemy, prioritizing champions. Immobilizing him or making him cast another ability ends the flight.
cards.counterplay: Account for escape routes across walls and look for immobilizing crowd control during his flight.

cards.answer: R sends a wave of fire that deals physical damage to enemies and heals Smolder. Enemies in the center take increased damage and are slowed.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the wave's center and account for his healing before committing to a finish.
